Inquiry.title: Inquiry
Inquiry.description: Represents a user inquiry submitted through the contact form.

name.description: Name of the person submitting the inquiry.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number of the person submitting the inquiry.

message.description: The message content of the inquiry.

submittedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the inquiry was submitted.

PortfolioProject.title: PortfolioProject
PortfolioProject.description: Represents a portfolio project showcased on the landing page.

id.description: Unique identifier for the portfolio project.

description.description: Detailed description of the portfolio project.

imageUrl.description: URL of the image showcasing the project.

projectUrl.description: URL of the deployed or source code for the project.

/inquiries/{inquiryId}.description: Stores user inquiries submitted through the contact form.

/portfolio_projects/{projectId}.description: Stores information about portfolio projects to be showcased.
